strings.name: Dong Mingzhu
strings.summary: Born in Nanjing, Dong worked at a research institution before moving to Zhuhai for air-conditioner sales in 1990 and rising through Gree’s management. She promoted distribution, quality and domestic branding, later pursuing diversification. Chair from 2012, she relinquished the presidency in 2025. Her management style and remarks against hiring overseas-educated Chinese drew public controversy.
